findings.claim: RECOVERY reports a rate ratio, but the page labels and pools it as a cumulative risk ratio alongside count-derived risk ratios. The printed estimate and limits match; their estimand classification does not.

source_evidence.quote: Of the 452 patients who underwent randomization, 438 (294 in the tocilizumab group and 144 in the placebo group) were included in the primary and secondary analyses.

findings.claim: The pooled population is not uniformly intention-to-treat as randomized. COVACTA contributes its modified intention-to-treat subset, excluding randomized participants.

source_evidence.quote: The patients were randomly distributed by block randomization to take either standard-of-care (SOC) plus 1 or 2 doses of tocilizumab 8 mg/kg or SOC alone.

findings.claim: The stated exclusion for having no eligible comparator is false: this randomized COVID-19 trial explicitly compares tocilizumab plus standard care with standard care alone.

findings.page_quote: EMPACTA and the CORIMUNO trials report death-or-ventilation COMPOSITES.

source_evidence.quote: Death from any cause by day 28 occurred in 10.4% of the patients in the tocilizumab group and 8.6% of those in the placebo group

findings.claim: The explanation for the extraction gap misleadingly characterizes EMPACTA as reporting a composite instead of separate mortality. Its abstract explicitly reports standalone 28-day all-cause mortality.

source_evidence.quote: Funded by F. Hoffmann-La Roche and the Department of Health and Human Services

findings.claim: The publication's funding is labeled not stated even though its abstract explicitly identifies both funders. This also conflicts with the separately listed COVACTA registry funding.

source_evidence.quote: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 38 of 250 patients (15.2%) in the tocilizumab group and 25 of 127 patients (19.7%) in the placebo group.

findings.claim: EMPACTA's serious-adverse-event row carries the efficacy composite as its endpoint definition and labels its safety population modified intention-to-treat. These compatibility labels do not describe the extracted harm counts.
